classification_rule: Exact-source descriptive classification only. Priority/family/activity labels do not grant execution, merge, deployment, installation, runtime, or effect authority.

subjects.purpose: Deterministic source-bound registry for signs, contextual interpretations, provenance, revision history, and explicit interpretation relations.
subjects.status: v0.2 corpus discipline is in progress; the kernel explicitly does not infer meaning, confidence, truth, or relations.
subjects.current_frontier: Establish evaluation evidence before admitting learned/probabilistic interpretation, while preserving source-bound readings versus generated hypotheses.

subjects.purpose: Public GitHub profile and descriptive portfolio presentation surface.
subjects.status: Profile README and visual assets present portfolio relationships and explicitly disclaim that the topology implies one live runtime.
subjects.current_frontier: Keep presentation claims subordinate to canonical repository/runtime evidence; do not use profile prose as project currentness or authority.

subjects.purpose: Remote MCP ingress, authenticated device attachment, and orchestration surface for the WorkBridge Commander path.
subjects.status: Remote service/device-agent source is on main; source explicitly preserves Desktop Commander workstation semantics and does not establish a deployed endpoint, installed workstation payload, or remote effect.
subjects.current_frontier: Qualify endpoint/authentication, revocation, session isolation, exact routing, and workstation-payload binding without laundering remote reachability into workstation authority.

subjects.purpose: Standalone provider-neutral bounded Go MCP workstation server plus independent Synology WorkBridge packaging.
subjects.status: Derived from an earlier WorkBridgeMCP Go-server cut and now independently evolving; WorkBridgeRelay 0002 source is on main while a separate process-argument hardening/package-0003 candidate is under qualification.
subjects.current_frontier: Qualify independent source/build/package hardening and establish explicit donor-patch currentness so security fixes do not silently diverge across the WorkBridgeMCP-derived lineage.

cross_subject_boundaries.WorkBridgeMCP: Primary workstation implementation/qualification source containing both bounded native and exact Desktop Commander duplicate models; not aliased by this classification.
cross_subject_boundaries.workbridgecommander: Distinct remote transport/orchestration surface with zero observed shared blobs against the two implementation repositories at reviewed main heads.
cross_subject_boundaries.workbridge: Derived standalone bounded-Go/Synology implementation lineage requiring independent currentness and qualification.
cross_subject_boundaries.profile: Presentation is descriptive evidence only, never canonical system state.
